verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs describe Gemini working on the user's mail inside the product. It summarizes long threads into bullet points, offers one-click suggested replies in the user's voice, refines drafts, and proposes meeting times from Google Calendar availability. Together these are AI-generated insights and suggestions drawn from the user's data. Missing for 10: evidence of broader mailbox-level insights beyond per-thread summaries and suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of these Gemini features.
